7 انخضد It (wood, or a branch, or twig, whether moist or dry,) broke so that its parts did not separate; as also ↓ تخضّد . (L, K.) ―
-b2- It (fruit, A, K, fresh, or moist, TA, being carried from one place to another, A, TA) became broken in pieces, (A, K,) or crushed; (K;) and so ↓ تخضّد . (A.) ―
-b3- It (wood, or a branch, or twig,) bent without breaking (AZ, S, L) asunder. (AZ, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
